dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Many factors must be considered when managing an orchard. It's not necessarily easier than combat or chess.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Lost time from delayed weed removal can interfere with fruit quality and ultimately affect the taste of the wine.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I can assist you if necessary. Strive to become a qualified manager.
